binaries.name: git
binaries.purpose: to check that the codebase is at the named commit with nothing changed, to list the files it tracks, and on drift to read what changed since the last record's commit

directories.name: records
directories.purpose: one folder per job, holding the model's draft, the calls, the baseline run's log and what the job went without

directories.name: work
directories.purpose: one folder per job, holding the codebase unpacked from its archive and the baseline run's own home and temporary folders
